children: GoPro entered into a financing agreement issuing a $20 million convertible debenture to Yorkville, the third closing under a previously disclosed $50 million program. The note carries a 3% original issue discount, matures Aug 26, 2027, and is convertible at the lower of $1.35 or 98% of the lowest five-day VWAP, subject to a $0.1736 floor and a 4.99% ownership cap. Interest applies only upon specified events, including 5% during certain adjustments or 18% upon default or capped conversions. The issuance completes availability under the program and is expected to bolster liquidity and financial flexibility.
: Convertible debenture issuance (Third Closing under $50 million program)
